stages.name: spec-lint
details: [LINT-HY-007] hypotheses[4].description: Hypothesis appears to describe what will NOT be built; hypotheses must be affirmative and testable

master_key_env_only.statement: The password is read from VAULT_MASTER_KEY; a missing variable exits 1 and no CLI argument supplies a password.

kdf_and_salt.statement: vault.py uses PBKDF2HMAC SHA-256 with 200000 iterations, and vault.enc starts with a 16-byte random salt that differs between vaults.

key_validation_lowercase.statement: Keys not matching [a-zA-Z0-9_]{1,64} exit 1; valid keys are stored lowercase so SET Foo is read by get foo.

value_size_limit.statement: A value of 4096 UTF-8 bytes is accepted and 4097 bytes (including multibyte) exits 1.

ttl_default_and_iso.statement: Without --ttl the stored expiry is about 90 days ahead, --ttl DAYS overrides it, and the expiry is an ISO-8601 string.

get_value_only.statement: get on a valid key prints exactly the value (plus newline) on stdout and nothing on stderr.

expired_exit_3.statement: get on an expired key exits 3 and the value appears in neither stdout nor stderr.

list_masks_value.statement: list prints each key with value[:4] followed by *** and never the full value.

delete_and_rotate.statement: delete removes a key; rotate replaces an existing value and exits 1 when the key does not exist.

audit_last_20.statement: Every command appends a line to ~/.vault/audit.log and audit prints only the last 20 lines.

no_value_leak.statement: After set, get, rotate and failing commands, neither audit.log nor stderr contains the secret value.
must_include: never write values to audit log or stderr

lockout_after_three.statement: Three wrong passwords create ~/.vault/.lockout and exit 2; further commands, even with the right password, exit 2.

file_permissions.statement: vault.enc has mode 0600 and the ~/.vault/ directory has mode 0700 after writes.
